app.title: The entire city of San Francisco as a video game
app.author: centrosphere
app.description: An interactive, procedurally generated 3D representation of San Francisco that users can explore as a simple video game.
proposed_tests: Load the website and confirm the 3D scene renders correctly
Navigate to a known landmark and verify coordinate accuracy
Measure frame rate and memory usage under default settings
Test keyboard and mouse controls for navigation
Check that the asset loading progress completes without errors
